title: The Playgroup
hook: Peppa 带 George 第一次去幼儿园，一开始嫌他小，后来发现弟弟很厉害。

cells.q: Where were Peppa and George going?
cells.a: Daddy Pig was taking them to the playgroup.
cells.cn: 猪爸爸送他们去幼儿园。

cells.q: What did Peppa want to do?
cells.a: She wanted to play with the big children.

cells.q: What did Suzy Sheep wish for?
cells.a: She wished she had a little brother like George.
cells.cn: 她希望自己也有个像 George 一样的弟弟。

cells.q: What did George do with his dinosaur?
cells.a: He held it up and roared, “Grrr! Dine-saw!”

cells.q: What did Peppa say about George?
cells.a: She said, “George is my brother. He's brilliant.”
cells.cn: 她说：“George 是我弟弟，他很棒。”

cells.a: She taught him how to paint a flower.
She looked at the pictures and said, “What do we have here?”
cells.cn: 羚羊老师看着画问：“你们画了什么呀？”

cells.a: Madame Gazelle said they should go on the wall.
cells.cn: 老师说这两幅画要挂到墙上。

cells.q: What did Madame Gazelle ask George to do?
cells.a: She asked him to show everyone how to paint a dinosaur.

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: playgroup, brother, dinosaur, paint, wall, show
helper.actions: go, wish, roar, teach, look, show

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “The Playgroup”.
ending: In the end, George shows everyone how to paint a dinosaur. My favourite part is ______.
